note: Built-in driving presets of TOD Mod Studio. type: per vehicle row, mul/add act on the shipped value of that vehicle, set is absolute. car: shared by all cars, set only. restore: true = remove every driving value (back to the game).

Mass.tip: Weight of the car for driving: heavier speeds up and brakes slower

drag_coeff.tip: Air drag: higher means a lower top speed

BrakeForce.tip: Brake power: higher stops shorter (S brakes with two thirds of it)

cornering_stiffness.tip: How fast steering fades with speed: lower keeps grip, higher breaks away sooner

lateral_slide_speed.tip: Slowest speed a slide or a handbrake spin can start

front_slide_factor.tip: How much the nose follows the tail in a slide

brake_slide_factor.tip: How far the tail swings when you brake in a turn

brake_front_slide_factor.tip: How much the nose follows the tail when braking in a turn

slide_factor.tip: How sideways the tail goes in a slide (0 = never slides)

control_speed.tip: How fast a slide builds and heads for a spin-out

time_to_slide_factor.tip: How long a slide lasts before the car spins out

handbrake_boost.tip: Extra kick of the handbrake spin (0 = none)

spinning_linear_friction.tip: Speed lost while the car is spinning: lower keeps it sliding

spinning_angular_friction.tip: How quickly a spin dies out: higher straightens up sooner

crash_angular_friction.tip: How quickly a crash spin dies out

rolling_res.tip: Rolling resistance: higher means a lower top speed

turn_rate.tip: How fast the wheels turn (a step is 0.04 s)

slide_angle.tip: How much steering has to be lost before a slide starts: lower slides sooner

powerslide_minimum_turnrate.tip: Steering amount above which a slide builds

sideways_slide_resistance.tip: How long a braking slide lasts once you straighten up

standard_sideways_slide_resistance.tip: How long a slide lasts once you straighten up: higher drifts out slowly

sideways_static_resistance.tip: Sideways speed below which a slide ends

tipsOnly.collision_mass: Weight in crashes: heavier shoves others harder
tipsOnly.WheelRadius: Wheel size; also how close to the ground counts as touching
tipsOnly.Inertial_Length: Size of the box the car turns around: longer turns slower
tipsOnly.Inertial_Width: Size of the box the car turns around
tipsOnly.Inertial_Height: Size of the box the car turns around
tipsOnly.spring_k: Body bounce in the picture only; no effect on driving
tipsOnly.spring_damping: Body bounce in the picture only; no effect on driving
tipsOnly.stiffness: Body bounce in the picture only; no effect on driving
tipsOnly.Health: Damage the car takes before it blows up
tipsOnly.static_brake_resistance: Braking below this speed stops the car dead
tipsOnly.rolling_static_threshold: Coasting below this speed stops the car dead
tipsOnly.burn_out_speed: How long a burnout (brake and gas) can last

presets.name: Drift
presets.tip: Loose tail, quick steering, a handbrake that throws the car sideways, and it stays catchable

presets.name: Grip
presets.tip: Sticks to the road, steers at any speed, hard to spin

presets.name: Heavy
presets.tip: Weighty: slower to move and stop, wide and lazy in a slide

presets.name: Vanilla
presets.tip: The values the game shipped with
